answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks with modularity clustering. Honest agents trade across a wide grove of partners, forming loose, open communities, while a farm's accounts mostly transact with each other, making a dense, closed cluster. Each epoch the network runs Louvain community detection; a cluster whose internal edge density far exceeds its outside links is quarantined and its rewards frozen until members prove outside connections. A sable ledger records every quarantine, and any agent can anchor an appeal with trades with strangers, so real communities escape false positives.
